cards.text: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: They've been standing outside for an hour, pretending to read a bus timetable.

choices.result_text: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: They bring what they can carry. Their old employers will count what's missing.

choices.result_text: PROSE-REVIEW placeholder: They nod as if they expected it, and don't look back.
